name: Your Enemies
overview: Scripture teaches that believers are called to respond to their enemies with kindness and mercy, exemplified by actions such as returning a neighbor’s lost animal (Exodus 23:4) and providing for an enemy’s needs when hungry or thirsty (Proverbs 25:21). Rather than rejoicing in their downfall, we are urged to withhold gladness at their stumbles (Proverbs 24:17), reflecting a heart aligned with God's peace that can even reconcile enemies (Proverbs 16:7). Trusting in God's protection amid opposition (Psalms 138:7) and following Christ’s example (Matthew 5:1) encourages believers to love and forgive their enemies as a demonstration of genuine faith.
